flat.about: Poisson re-rolls of 14 bins of 2 MeV at the level of the real flat bins (simulated). rolls[r][i] is the count of bin i in re-roll r; edges as the real bins.

falling.about: A falling spectrum (simulated): density proportional to exp(slope (m - lo)/(hi - lo)) on lo-hi GeV, 30 bins of 10 MeV, 140 entries a roll, 20 rolls drawn one after another from one generator. z is the one-sided Poisson significance of each bin against its expected count (p = P(N >= n | expected), z = Phi^-1(1-p)); an alarm fires where z >= 2. The roll with the largest z is then grown to 3 500 entries by adding 3 360 more from the same generator.

curve.about: The toy's own expectation as dk-curve parameter sets (f 'exp': a exp(slope (x - pivot)) per bin of `bin` GeV), set 0 for 140 entries and set 1 for 3 500. In a deck: dk-curve with src 'toys.json', sets ['falling.curve.sets.0', 'falling.curve.sets.1'], f 'exp', range [1.45, 1.75], pull false. check: the curve at the bin centres against expected140 / expected3500 (the bin integrals).

tail.about: Standard normal tail areas (one-sided unless named), and what a 300 000-grain bell shows.

source.title: Seeded toy samples (simulated)
source.note: Simulated with numpy.random.default_rng; seeds are given with each sample. The flat level comes from record 401 (d0-flat.json).
